frames.target_pose: 徒手扶稳站立，双脚接地，测试侧大腿自然向下
frames.prompt:
Identity-preserving rehabilitation photo edit. Input image 1 is the accepted camera and equipment base for this exercise group: it shows the woman side-on, holding a fixed grey waist-high rail, standing on one bare foot with the other knee bent. Input images 2–4 are the ORIGINAL strict same-woman face/age/black low ponytail/white short sleeve shirt/charcoal long trousers/soft real photo/grey-blue background references.
Produce the STARTING STEP of the same exercise. Change ONLY the bent testing lower leg so its knee is gently straightened and that bare foot lowered onto the SAME flat floor directly next to the supporting foot. Both feet now rest fully on the ground, both thighs hang naturally downward. Keep the supporting leg, its grounded foot and every part of torso, head, face, upper body, hand contact on rail, relaxed other arm, rail location and dimensions, studio backdrop and floor, shadows, lens/camera angle, scale, crop and composition exactly fixed. The testing knee stays directly below its hip, do not swing whole leg back or sideways. No weights or resistance bands. Show a stable normal upright posture, complete woman and both feet, natural adult proportions. Preserve the original 1122×1402 vertical canvas, one single photograph, one moment, no text, number, diagram, arrows, inset, collage or extra person.

frames.prompt:

Input images 2–4 are the ORIGINAL strict identity/face/age/low black ponytail/white T-shirt/charcoal trousers/soft real-photo/grey-blue backdrop references.
Make STEP 01 starting position by changing ONLY pelvis and associated upper thighs: lower pelvis gently so the buttocks and lower back REST on the grey mat, clearly no bridge and no air gap under pelvis. Keep shoulders, head and neck supported in their EXACT existing position on the same small grey head support, both arms/hands at same mat locations, torso length, both feet/heels at EXACT same positions firmly resting on the same sliders, toes natural, knee bend comfortably bent. Knees may settle slightly with pelvis lowering, but heels and sliders must not slide or move. Do not lift either foot, do not substitute one-leg version, towel or shoes. Keep the mat shape/position/edge, complete whole body including both bare feet/sliders, studio grey-blue background and floor, light, camera viewpoint, person scale, cropping and 1122×1402 vertical canvas completely unchanged. One real photograph, no text/arrows/labels/collage/inset, normal adult limb proportions.

frames.name: 仰卧带辅助温和后侧链牵伸
frames.target_pose: 仰卧，测试大腿舒适抬高且膝较弯，非弹性带绕前足本人双手握
frames.prompt:
Identity-preserving rehabilitation photo pose edit. Input image 1 fixes the SAME group camera, mat, floor, head pillow, full body scale/composition, opposite resting leg, woman's face and clothing. Input images 2–4 are ORIGINAL strict face/age/black low ponytail/white short-sleeved T-shirt/charcoal trousers/grey-blue soft-light real-photo references.
Create STEP 01 for gentle self-assisted hamstring stretch. Preserve the current raised TESTING THIGH femur position and HIP FLEXION ANGLE exactly, comfortably raised around70–80° relative to mat; keep hip and knee centre at the existing high thigh location. Change the TESTING KNEE so it is CLEARLY MORE BENT, approximately60–70° knee flexion, by moving only the lower leg and bare foot downward/forward. Do not drop or lift the whole thigh. Keep a grey NON-ELASTIC stretching strap looping securely around the BALL/FOREFOOT of this bare foot, not the toes. She personally holds the two strap ends with BOTH hands in a natural controllable gentle grip; hands and strap tension may settle to accommodate bent knee, elbows can relax; no external assistant. Foot and ankle remain relaxed and not strongly dorsiflexed. Head and neck stay supported on same grey pad, no neck curl. Other leg remains fully supported on mat in the exact same relaxed position, no bending/moving it. Natural adult thigh and shin lengths and no stretched anatomy. Keep full head/face, both hands, raised thigh/knee/foot, opposite foot and mat visible on SAME1122×1402 portrait canvas. Same camera/framing/grey-blue seamless studio and soft photo lighting. One moment, no labels/text/arrows/inset/collage or new apparatus. This bent-knee setup is not a straight-leg raise.

frames.prompt:
Precisely local rehabilitation STEP02 edit of accepted STEP01. Image1 is the accepted starting frame of this exact group: woman supine on mat, head/neck supported, other leg relaxed resting straight on mat, testing THIGH raised and testing KNEE bent, non-elastic grey strap around forefoot held by both hands. Images2–4 are the ORIGINAL identity/face/age/low black ponytail/white short sleeve T-shirt/charcoal pants/grey-blue soft realistic photographic references.
CRITICAL: freeze the HIP POSITION, femur angle, entire raised THIGH, and KNEE CENTRE exactly as image1. Only extend the testing KNEE somewhat, reducing the knee bend from its current roughly55–65° to a comfortable25–35°, still clearly SOFT/BENT and never locked. This changes only the LOWER LEG and FOOT about the FIXED knee; foot will move upward/closer to line of thigh naturally without raising the thigh or changing hip angle. Preserve original femur and shin lengths. Do not turn this into a straight-leg-raise. Keep the same grey NON-ELASTIC strap securely around the same BALL/FOREFOOT, not toes. Both hands personally hold the two ends, elbows relaxed and gentle controlled assistance; adjust strap span/hand hold only as needed for knee change. Foot/ankle neutral and relaxed, no forced dorsiflexion. Everything else must stay pixel-location consistent: head/neck support and face, upper torso, pelvis, opposite leg/foot, mat/edges, floor/backdrop, light, camera angle/lens/crop/person scale and1122×1402 vertical canvas. Head stays on pad, no neck curl. Complete raised foot, both hands and both legs visible. Normal adult body proportions; one photo/moment, no labels/arrows/diagram/collage/inset/new props.
